  "scorecard": [
    {
      "promise": "De-merger to happen in November",
      "made_in": "Oct 2025",
      "quote": "The NCLT approval has come through so this is something that the de-merger will happen in November, but we are waiting for the written judgment",
      "outcome": "De-merger completion details not reported in later metrics or financials.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Jan 2026 / Apr 2026 reported statements"
    },
    {
      "promise": "RERTC generation expected from sometime next year",
      "made_in": "Oct 2025",
      "quote": "we are on track in terms of both the panel production in terms of being ready with the first line for cells as well as the important one in terms of development of cuts so that RERTC can be generated from sometime next year.",
      "outcome": "Next year horizon (2026) is ongoing; specific RERTC generation reported metrics were not provided in subsequent calls.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Jul 2026 / Nov 2026 calls"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Connecting a million homes every month to continue and grow",
      "made_in": "Oct 2025",
      "quote": "We expect that trend to continue. In fact, if anything, keep growing with our wireless broadband offerings",
      "outcome": "Subscriber base grew to 515.3M in Q3 FY26 and 524.4M in Q4 FY26.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Jan 2026 and Apr 2026 reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Expand Gemini Pro offer to other users over time",
      "made_in": "Jan 2026",
      "quote": "We do plan to expand this to other users as well in the course of time.",
      "outcome": "No update provided on Gemini Pro expansion in subsequent reported items.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Apr 2026 / Jul 2026 calls"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Data consumption and operating metrics to grow healthily with AI",
      "made_in": "Apr 2026",
      "quote": "expecting this to keep growing like this with more use cases coming in now within AI-enabled use cases",
      "outcome": "JPL Revenue reached Rs.39,173 Cr in Q1 FY27 and Rs.40,475 Cr in Q2 FY27; ARPU rose to Rs 218.8.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Jul 2026 / Nov 2026 reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Grow online businesses rapidly and expand dark stores this year",
      "made_in": "Jul 2026",
      "quote": "We are looking at growing our online businesses pretty rapidly during this year, so we will expand dark stores, we will grow our omni-channel platforms",
      "outcome": "FY27 is currently ongoing; Retail Revenue reached Rs.90,000 Cr in Q2 FY27.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Nov 2026 reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Scale benefits converting to margins and cash over next 2 years",
      "made_in": "Jul 2026",
      "quote": "the benefit of that scale will convert into value in terms of margins and cash generation over the next two years.",
      "outcome": "2-year period ends in FY28; OPM % stood at 17% in Sep 2026 quarterly results.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Sep 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "New energy earnings contribution starting in FY 2028",
      "made_in": "Nov 2026",
      "quote": "new energy, I just wanted to say that it is accelerating and we see the benefit, earnings contribution definitely starting in FY 2028.",
      "outcome": "FY 2028 has not started yet.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Nov 2026 call"
    }
  ],
  "credibility": {
    "delivered": 2,
    "partly": 0,
    "missed": 0,
    "summary": "Management sets long-horizon targets with good delivery on operational telecom subscriber metrics, while structural and new energy targets are mostly ongoing or pending."
  },
  "narrative_vs_numbers": [
    "Jio operating momentum narrative matches steady quarterly ARPU gains (Rs 213.7 in Q3 FY26 to Rs 218.8 in Q2 FY27).",
    "Reported revenue growth accelerated sharply to 30% YoY in Sep 2026, aligning with positive revenue outlooks."
  ]
}
